title: Request Redaction
description: Mask secrets and personal data before requests are forwarded upstream. The model only sees placeholders; usage logs show what was masked.

general.title: General
general.description: Redaction runs on the final request body sent to each provider. Placeholders are deterministic, so the same value always gets the same placeholder and prompt caching keeps working.
general.enabledHint: When on, every outbound request is scanned and matching values are replaced with placeholders.
general.recordOriginals: Store original values in usage logs
general.recordOriginalsHint: When off, redaction records keep only a masked preview of each value.
general.incrementalTtlHoursHint: How long a session remembers values it already reported, so later turns only log newly added content.
general.allowlistHint: One value per line. These exact values (case-insensitive) are never masked.

builtin.title: Built-in Rules
builtin.description: Vendor credentials and checksum-validated personal data are on by default. Rules that often match ordinary code are off by default: masking them can break edits of files that contain the values.

rules.title: Custom & Discovered Rules
rules.description: Your own rules and rules discovered by Jev. Pending rules do nothing until approved.

dialog.description: Matches are replaced with a placeholder built from the label.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.label: Placeholder label
dialog.labelHint: Upper-case letters, digits and underscores, e.g. INTERNAL_TOKEN.
dialog.flagsHint: Any of i, m, s, u.
dialog.groupHint: 0 masks the whole match; a number masks only that group.

jev.title: Jev Auto-Discovery
jev.description: Values that no rule covers yet (secret-looking assignments, random-looking tokens, passwords in URLs) are judged by TypeSafe Jev. Confident verdicts become active rules automatically; less confident ones wait for review. Each value is judged only once.
jev.privacyNote: In masked mode Jev never receives the value itself, only its shape and the surrounding text with known sensitive values already masked.
jev.apiKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved key ({preview})
jev.modeSync: Sync: wait for the verdict (up to the timeout) so the first occurrence is already masked
jev.modeAsync: Async: never delay requests; new rules apply from the next request
jev.autoEnableThresholdHint: Verdicts at or above this confidence become active rules immediately.
jev.suggestThresholdHint: Verdicts at or above this confidence (but below auto-enable) become pending rules.
jev.sendModeMasked: Masked: only the value's shape (prefix, length, character classes, entropy)
jev.sendModeFull: Full: the candidate value itself (more accurate)

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Run the saved rules against sample text (works even while redaction is off). Nothing is sent to Jev.
playground.placeholder: Paste text to test, e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
playground.candidatesHint: With Jev enabled, these values would be sent for a verdict.

logs.badgeTooltip: {count} new values masked in this request ({total} in total including earlier turns)
logs.title: Redaction
logs.summary: {count} values newly masked in this request. {total} values were masked in total, including earlier turns of the session.
logs.maskedOriginal: Original values were not stored; a masked preview is shown.

errors.INVALID_LABEL: Label must use upper-case letters, digits and underscores (max 48)
errors.LITERAL_TOO_SHORT: Exact values must have at least 4 characters
errors.BROAD_PATTERN: The pattern is too broad: it matches empty text or most ordinary prose
errors.INVALID_GROUP: The capture group does not exist in the pattern
errors.DUPLICATE_RULE: A rule for this value already exists

builtinNames.google_api_key: Google API key / OAuth client secret

records.title: Redaction Records
records.description: What was masked in outbound requests, and what Jev discovery judged and learned.

stats.jevCallsHint: {candidates} candidates sent, {failed} failed, {timedOut} over the wait timeout
stats.pendingReview: {count, plural, one {# discovered rule is} other {# discovered rules are}} waiting for review
stats.noTopRules: Nothing was masked in this range.

events.empty: No redaction records in this range.

jev.empty: No Jev calls in this range.
jev.emptyHint: Jev is called only when Jev discovery is enabled and a request contains candidate values that have not been judged before.
jev.maskedValues: Original values were not stored; masked previews are shown.
